review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Heart2Beatz Inc. is a technology and media company focused on building digital platforms, producing entertainment content, and delivering interactive audience engagement solutions. The organization blends software innovation with creative media to connect audiences with immersive digital experiences. Team members collaborate across product, engineering, and content disciplines to launch scalable, user-centric platforms. Heart2Beatz Inc. values experimentation, agility, and data-informed decisions to drive continuous improvement and growth. Role Description The Full Stack Engineer will work remotely in a full-time capacity, designing, developing, and maintaining end-to-end web applications. Day-to-day responsibilities include implementing front-end interfaces, building and optimizing back-end services and APIs, integrating databases, and ensuring responsive, accessible user experiences. The role involves collaborating with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into robust technical solutions, as well as reviewing code, troubleshooting issues, and improving performance and security. The engineer will participate in agile workflows, contribute to architectural decisions, write clean and testable code, and help evolve development standards and best practices. Qualifications Strong skills in Full-Stack Development and Software Development across modern web technologies. Proficiency in Front-End Development, including HTML, JavaScript frameworks, and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS). Experience in Back-End Web Development using server-side languages, frameworks, and RESTful APIs. Knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases and familiarity with cloud platforms or containerization tools. Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; experience with version control (e.g., Git). Comfort working in remote, collaborative environments and participating in agile or iterative development processes. Strong problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills; commitment to inclusive, user-centric design. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; prior experience in media or digital platforms is a plus.

review_candidates.title: C/C++ DSP CUDA Software Engineer (this position is open to candidates based anywhere in Europe)
review_candidates.description: As a Senior  CUDA DSP Engineer , you will port our 5G positioning signal-processing algorithms from CPU reference implementations to high-throughput, low-latency CUDA implementations on NVIDIA GPUs. You will work closely with signal-processing domain experts to meet real-time latency targets, maximise memory-bandwidth utilisation, and maintain strict numerical parity with the algorithm prototypes. The work is hands-on kernel development, library integration, and performance validation. Responsibilities: Port existing signal processing algorithms to high-throughput, low-latency CUDA GPU implementations. Write, test, and tune custom CUDA C/C++ kernels using shared memory, registers, warp shuffles, and asynchronous copy primitives. Replace CPU library calls (Intel MKL and IPP) with NVIDIA math and signal processing libraries including cuFFT, cuBLAS, cuSignal, and NPP. Implement asynchronous processing pipelines using CUDA streams and pinned host memory to overlap PCIe data transfers with compute. Design unit and integration test suites that verify functional equivalence between reference and GPU pipeline outputs. Maintain clear architectural documentation and collaborate with domain engineering teams. Your profile:  4+ years of professional C/C++ development experience, including 3+ years writing low-level CUDA applications for NVIDIA GPUs. High proficiency in C multithreading and low-level memory management. Working knowledge of core DSP concepts, including FFT, MUSIC, and parameter estimation.  Hands-on experience identifying hardware bottlenecks using Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute. Based in the US or Europe, with working hours that overlap with our engineering teams in Romania and the US. M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Experience with Intel vector intrinsics (AVX2, AVX-512), Intel IPP, or Intel MKL. Familiarity with Python wrappers for GPU acceleration such as PyCUDA, CuPy, or RAPIDS cuSignal. Background in parameter estimation, geolocation, software-defined radio, or 5G telecommunications.

review_candidates.title: Data Scientist (Growth) | Remote
review_candidates.description: Role: Product / Growth Data Scientist Engagement: Remote | Contract / Freelance Experience: 4+ years hands-on experience; 5+ years preferred Education: Master’s degree or higher About the Role We are looking for experienced Product or Growth Data Scientists with strong hands-on expertise in experimentation, product analytics, statistical modeling, and decision-making. The ideal candidate should regularly work with SQL, Python, statistics, A/B testing, product metrics, retention, LTV, and causal/uplift analysis . Key Responsibilities Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and controlled experiments . Define and monitor product KPIs, north-star metrics, funnels, and behavioral metrics. Analyze user acquisition, engagement, conversion, churn, and retention. Build statistical models for retention, lifetime value (LTV), uplift, and user behavior . Perform hypothesis testing, regression analysis, segmentation, and causal analysis. Translate complex data into actionable product and growth recommendations. Work extensively with large datasets using SQL and Python . Required Qualifications 4+ years of hands-on Data Science experience; 5+ years preferred. Master’s degree or higher in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. Strong daily hands-on experience with SQL, Python, and statistics . Strong practical experience with A/B testing and experimentation . Experience defining and analyzing product or growth metrics. Hands-on experience with retention, churn, LTV, uplift, or causal modeling . Strong statistical fundamentals including hypothesis testing, regression, confidence intervals, and experimental design. Active and credible professional LinkedIn profile. Preferred Background Product Data Scientist, Growth Data Scientist, Decision Scientist, Experimentation Data Scientist, Product Analytics Data Scientist, or similar.
